# discord_soundboard_sound (Resource)

Manages a server soundboard sound. Requires the Create Expressions permission, and Manage Expressions for sounds uploaded by others.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_soundboard_sound" "quack" {
  server_id  = var.server_id
  name       = "quack"
  sound      = "data:audio/mpeg;base64,${filebase64("${path.module}/quack.mp3")}"
  volume     = 0.5
  emoji_name = "🦆"
}

# With Terraform 1.11 or later, sound_wo keeps the sound out of state. Bump
# sound_wo_version to upload a new sound, which creates a new soundboard sound.
resource "discord_soundboard_sound" "cheer" {
  server_id        = var.server_id
  name             = "cheer"
  sound_wo         = "data:audio/ogg;base64,${filebase64("${path.module}/cheer.ogg")}"
  sound_wo_version = 1
  emoji_id         = discord_emoji.party.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Sound name (2-32 characters).
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `audit_log_reason` (String) Reason recorded in the server's audit log for changes this resource makes, overriding the provider's `audit_log_reason`. Up to 512 characters. Changing only this argument updates state without calling Discord.
- `emoji_id` (String) ID of a custom emoji for the sound. Conflicts with `emoji_name`.
- `emoji_name` (String) Unicode character of a standard emoji for the sound, e.g. `"🦆"`.
- `sound` (String) Sound as a base64 data URI (MP3 or Ogg, at most 512 KB and 5.2 seconds), e.g. `"data:audio/mpeg;base64,${filebase64("sound.mp3")}"`. Changing it uploads a new sound. Stored in state; prefer `sound_wo` on Terraform 1.11 or later. Exactly one of `sound` and `sound_wo` is required.
- `sound_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Sound as a base64 data URI (MP3 or Ogg, at most 512 KB and 5.2 seconds), e.g. `"data:audio/mpeg;base64,${filebase64("sound.mp3")}"`. Write-only: the value is never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later and `sound_wo_version`. Conflicts with `sound`.
- `sound_wo_version` (Number) Version of `sound_wo`. Changing it uploads `sound_wo` as a new sound.
- `volume` (Number) Volume from 0 to 1. Defaults to `1`.

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the sound can be used. It may be false after the server loses boosts.
- `id` (String) Soundboard sound ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = discord_soundboard_sound.quack
  identity = {
    server_id = "234567890123456789"
    sound_id  = "567890123456789012"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).
- `sound_id` (String) ID of the soundboard sound.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_soundboard_sound.quack <server_id>/<sound_id>
```
